# SimSIMD 6.5.16

Vendored from:

`https://github.com/ashvardanian/SimSIMD/archive/refs/tags/v6.5.16.tar.gz`

License:

Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE`.

This copy is used only for the signed-int8 distance/dot kernels needed by
RNSG `.i8bin` support. The repo intentionally uses the header-only,
compile-time dispatch path so local revision experiments do not depend on
GitHub/xrepo connectivity.
